name: Acidic Needle Launcher
disable: DC 36 Thievery check to disable some firing mechanisms, making three adjacent squares in the trapped area safe to enter.
routine: (3 actions) The acidic needle launcher fires a needle at a random target in the area indicated on the map.

items.name: Needle Rain
items.text:
Trigger A creature moves into the area indicated on the map

---

Effect The trap shoots an acidic needle at a random target in the area indicated on the map, then rolls initiative.

text: A ceiling-mounted launcher rains resinous needles onto intruders, after which the needles melt into acid.
